results.title: [PDF] Cogut Institute for the Humanities | Brown Bulletin
results.content: At the intersection of the humanities and social sciences, this course explores cultural practices constitutive of the diplomatic stage, international society, transnational networks, globalization, and postcoloniality in the 20th and 21st centuries. At the intersection of the humanities and social sciences, this course engages participants in new research on White House state dinners while drawing from a range of historical and global case studies from the early modern era to the present. The seminar will focus on a selection of these issues and developments especially relevant to the interests of humanities scholars and students of culture and cultural theory.
